policy: Batch 010 reuses POSITIVE_CONSTRAINT_RULESET_V1 unchanged. No case-specific threshold is introduced.

cases.rationale: Tariff-related input-price pressure and supply disruption appeared in the expected direction, and USITC later estimated causal effects on imports, prices and domestic production, but the historical hypothesis did not define a numeric success target.

Post-control export interruption and price pressure are consistent with the IEA concentration-risk mechanism, but USGS also identified demand conditions and other market factors alongside availability concerns, so clean single-cause attribution is not asserted.

The regulation produced a large reduction in shipping sulfur-oxide emissions consistent with the expected health/welfare mechanism, but the independent historical hypothesis did not define a numeric outcome target.
